messages:
olivia: Quick sync — thinking about the onboarding checklist + quickstart banner behaviour. Current ask: should the banner be dismissible permanently or should it persist until the checklist reaches 100%? :thinking_face:
kevin: my vote is persistent until completed. We lose activation if people dismiss too early. Maybe make dismissal temporary (7 days) and show a small icon in the header to reopen. :thumbsup:
maria: Agree re: reopen affordance. Also accessibility nit: when the banner is focused with keyboard, the dismiss control currently has no visible focus ring in our mock — needs a 2px high-contrast outline. :white_check_mark:
sam: From infra side, storing per-user checklist progress is cheap. We can persist a `onboarding.progress` flag in user prefs and surface a `seen_quickstart_until` timestamp for temporary dismissals. Example payload:```json
{"onboarding": {"checklist_progress": 40, "dismissed_quickstart_until": "2025-09-10T00:00:00Z"}}
```
kevin: nice, that helps the copy decisions. For copy, two options: A) "Finish setup: 5 steps to production" B) "Get started with Redwood: follow this quick checklist" — which reads better to you folks? :eyes:
dave: A feels more action-y. But lean shorter: "Finish setup — 5 quick steps". Also suggest we add ARIA live region updates when a step completes so screen readers announce progress.
maria: +1 to ARIA live region. Also keyboard behavior: the checklist items are toggleable checkboxes but currently they are not reachable inside the compact banner. Proposal: banner expands to a modal-like flyout with full keyboard focus trap when user activates "Continue setup". That keeps compactness but ensures accessible flows.
olivia: UX question: sample projects panel — should it be in the banner flyout or in the console empty state? We had feedback last week that sample projects are overwhelming in the banner.
kevin: Put 1-2 recommended samples in the flyout (short cards), and keep the full catalog in the empty state / projects page. Also show a small "Try this sample" CTA that pre-populates a project config.
sam: Implementation note: pre-populate will call `/api/projects/create?sample=chatbot-basic`. We'll need an optimistic UI path for the create and a fallback toast on failure. Deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging with onboard-banner branch at 2025-09-09T16:00Z :rocket:
maria: Copy tweak for CTA: instead of "Try sample" use "Try this template" — users on research said "template" maps better to 'starter app' idea. For contrast, ensure button text stays >= 4.5:1 on normal and hover states.
dave: One more accessibility nit: color of the progress pill (green) is currently only color-coded. Add a visible label (e.g., "2/5 steps") and an icon so color isn’t the sole indicator.
olivia: Great thread. Next steps: kevin to update mocks with focus rings + flyout; maria to write a11y checklist; sam to wire up persistence + API; dave to update copy suggestions. I'll schedule a 30m handoff tomorrow. :calendar:
